# Model asset provenance

`chinese-pool.min.gltf` and `chinese-pool.min.bin` are a project-local,
independently addressable Chinese pool table profile derived from the
repository's GPL-3.0 snooker table mesh. The runtime adds a dedicated steel
cushion outline and six rounded pocket collars, while the game continues to
use the selected rule's pool-table physics geometry.

The derived files and procedural additions are distributed under this
repository's GPL-3.0 license. No third-party model was added.
